events.name: Bash
events.head: Read price table, setup script references and task states
events.input: $ cat app/src/lib/prices.json | head -60; echo ---; git status --short app/src/lib/prices.json app/scripts/dodo-setup.mjs app/src/app/api/checkout/route.ts app/scripts/probe-live-wiring.mjs; git log --oneline -3 -- app/src/lib/prices.json; echo ---; grep -n "prices\|PRICES\|9900\|currency" app/scripts/dodo-setup.mjs | head -30; echo ---; python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show probe header and run the live wiring probe
events.input: $ sed -n 1,40p app/scripts/probe-live-wiring.mjs | cut -c1-200; (cd app && timeout 300 node scripts/probe-live-wiring.mjs 2>&1 | tail -40 | cut -c1-220)
